hints: Compare the two ventricles in a normal heart. Which side has the thicker muscle wall and has to generate much higher pressure to pump blood around the whole body?

If blood is pushed through the hole by that pressure difference, trace where it goes next: from the left ventricle into the right ventricle, then to the pulmonary artery and lungs. What does that mean for lung blood volume and for blood going to the body?
walkthrough:
**Recall normal left and right pressures**

Think side by side with me. The left ventricle pumps to the whole body, so it is thick walled and generates high pressure. The right ventricle only pumps to the nearby lungs, so its pressure is much lower.

Rule to remember: blood always flows from high pressure to low pressure.

**Work out the direction of the leak**

Because left pressure > right pressure, blood will be forced through the VSD hole mostly from left to right. That means oxygenated blood from the left leaks into the deoxygenated blood on the right.

So statement 1, which says mostly right to left, is the wrong way round.

**Follow the extra blood to the lungs and body**

That extra leaked blood is now in the right ventricle, so it gets pumped out in the pulmonary artery to the lungs. The lungs therefore receive more blood than normal, so statement 2 is correct.

At the same time, less blood leaves the left ventricle in the aorta to supply the body, and some mixing has occurred. So body tissues receive a lower volume of fully oxygenated blood, so statement 3 is correct. That gives 2 and 3 only.

options.A: Includes statement 1 which is incorrect, as the shunt is mostly left to right due to higher left ventricular pressure.
options.B: Includes statement 1 which is incorrect. Statement 2 alone is true, but pairing it with 1 makes this option wrong.
options.C: Includes statement 1 which is incorrect. Statement 3 alone is true, but pairing it with 1 makes this option wrong.
options.D: Correct, as statement 2 is true (extra left to right blood increases pulmonary flow) and statement 3 is true (less oxygenated blood reaches body tissues).
